comment: she is a terrible teacher, she does not help you out but do expect a lot from you.  she does not like certain students from different religion  and culture

I am a math-econ major and was forced to take this class. I am a decent writer and I figured that by taking expos. I would learn how to write at a college level. I was wrong, Prof. P taught us nothing. The only way you will learn anything about writing is to read the textbook, and she will not help you unless you are a girl. She is a terrible prof.

She is a really nice lady but she can't teach for the love of God. She is quite possibly the hardest grader ever, no matter how much work I do I'll always get a C to C+. She helpful outside of class but when she grades papers, her comments don't make sense. Assigns a lot of of random busy work, I don't recommend her.

Ugh.  This professor is useless.  Regardless of effort or quality of work, females will get a B, males get a C (or possibly a B if you are a giant suck up).  You really won't learn anything about writing in this class.

She is a terrible teacher, extremely hard grader even though she has no clue what she is talking about when it comes to writing. She does not teach you anything that would help one improve their writing .I had prof. Givens for core and got a higher grade than she gave me which says a lot. Do not take her if you would like to get above a C in expose
Didn't really teach or control the class, we ran it.

She is flat out the nicest, more caring, and helpful teacher I have ever had.  Loves to interact with students and tells great stories.  You really get to know her and her family very well.  Loves to email and proof read all papers.  If you are going to take this class.

awesome teacher.  her class is easy - she rarely shows up and we never have any work - doesnt count absences. on papers, shes a medium-hard grader but very managable. didnt give us a final because we told her it was scheduled too late and we didnt want it.  really works with the students - i HIGHLY recommend this class...

Hey You!..if u want to take an expository writing class, here's the one.  If you are looking for a great teacher who truly cares about you and your work, get Pat.  She tells stories a lot, will prolong essays if you have trouble, and will even correct papers you do for other classes.  Might be the nicest teacher i have, and i FLAT OUT RECOMMEND HER

She is very nice and understanding, very easy on absences. Dont really do anything in class, not a lot of work, however she grades essays very hard.  Everything is good except she is a harsh grader and may not seem like it from the way she conducts class
